Alphabet acgtn; vocabulary is all possible 5-mers (5^5=3125 features), deterministic index order. Lowercasing enabled; binary=False (count weights). transform_sequences/make_vectorizer utilities in data_representation.py.

model_architecture: LinearSVC (linear SVM)
data_representation: 4-mer character bag-of-words using scikit-learn CountVectorizer with analyzer='char', ngram_range=(4,4), lowercase=True, min_df=1, binary=False. Sequences are cleaned by lowercasing and replacing any non-acgtn character with 'n' (alphabet={a,c,g,t,n}). Vectorizer fitted on training sequences; saved as joblib alongside config.

model_architecture: Multinomial Naive Bayes (character 3-mer CountVectorizer representation)
data_representation: Implemented 3-mer character CountVectorizer representation per instructions. Added vectorizer_utils.py with cleaning (lowercase, map non-ACGTN to 'n'), builder, fit/save (vectorizer.joblib + config.json), load, and transform helpers. Vectorizer params: analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,3), lowercase=True, min_df=1, binary=False. Cleaned sequences are used for fitting and transforming; artifacts are saved to specified directory.

model_architecture: Shallow 1D CNN: Conv1d(5->64,kernel_size=7,padding=3)->ReLU->Conv1d(64->64,kernel_size=5,padding=2)->ReLU->(optional LayerNorm over channels)->Global Max Pool over length->Dropout(0.3)->Linear(64->1) for binary logit output
data_representation: DNA one-hot encoding to length 600: lowercase; map {a:0,c:1,g:2,t:3,n/other:4}; truncate/pad to 600 with n; tensor shape (len,5) one-hot floats. Dataset class reads CSV, encodes sequences; collate_fn stacks and permutes to (batch, channels=5, length=600); labels read from numeric_label if present.

model_architecture: Stronger 1D CNN (PyTorch): stem with 3 parallel Conv1d branches (in=5,out=64,kernel=7/11/15,padding="same"), GELU, concat -> 192ch; optional LayerNorm. Residual
data_representation: Reused iteration 3 representation: fixed-length 600 tokens per sequence; characters a/c/g/t/n mapped to 5-channel one-hot (order: a,c,g,t,n). Sequences are lowercased; any other character set to n. Training-only optional reverse-complement augmentation (p=0.5): reverse sequence and complement (a<->t, c<->g, n stays n) applied before one-hot or equivalently after encoding by flipping length dimension and swapping channels (a<->t, c<->g). Validation/inference have no augmentation. Dataset/loader keep pad-to-600 trimming or right-pad with n if shorter; collate stacks tensors into shape [B,5,600] and labels float32. No additional normalization.

model_architecture: StrongCNN-v5: triple-branch stem (kernels 7/11/15, padding=same) each outputting 80 channels -> concat 240; LayerNorm; three depthwise-separable residual blocks with 256 channels, kernels/dilations: (5,1), (7,2), (7,4); each block: depthwise conv -> pointwise conv -> GELU -> dropout 0.1 -> SE (r=4) -> LayerNorm -> residual add; head: global maxpool + avgpool concat -> 512-dim -> dropout 0.3 -> linear to 1 logit. Biases kept. Gradient clipping max_norm=1.0. EMA tracking (decay=0.999).
data_representation: Re-use the iteration 4 DNA encoder: lowercase sequences, map any non-ACGT to 'n', pad/crop to length 600; one-hot encode into 5 channels (A,C,G,T,N). Dataset applies reverse-complement augmentation with p=0.5 during training only (disabled for validation/test).

model_architecture: HuggingFace AutoModelForSequenceClassification initialized from 'InstaDeepAI/nucleotide- transformer-v2-50m-3mer-multi-species' (3-mer), num_labels=2, problem_type='single_label_classification', full fine-tuning (no layers frozen), default dropout, softmax outputs
data_representation: Sequences are lowercased and any non-ACGT character is replaced with 'n'. A HuggingFace tokenizer from 'InstaDeepAI/nucleotide-transformer-v2-50m-3mer-multi-species' is used to tokenize sequences into 3-mer tokens with max_length=600, padding='max_length', and truncation=True, returning PyTorch tensors. A custom OCRDataset reads CSVs with columns 'sequence' and 'numeric_label', returning input_ids, attention_mask, and label tensors. Tokenizer can be loaded via load_tokenizer; datasets created via get_datasets(train_csv, val_csv, tokenizer=None, max_length=600).

model_architecture: StrongCNNV6 (3-branch stem Conv1d kernels 7/11/15, concat 288->LayerNorm, 1x1 proj to 320; 4 depthwise-separable residual blocks with SE (reduction=4), GELU, LayerNorm, Dropout 0.15, stochastic depth up to 0.1, dilations 1/2/4/8 with kernels 5/7/7/7; head: GMP+GAP concat 640 -> Dropout 0.35 -> Linear 640→1 logit; bias=True; gradient clipping max_norm=1.0).
data_representation: Reused iteration 5 one-hot DNA encoder: lowercase sequences, map non-ACGT to 'n'; one-hot over 5 channels [A,C,G,T,N]; pad/truncate to fixed length 600; torch tensor float32. Reverse-complement augmentation applied only during training (p=0.5). Data loader uses same representation in data_representation.py copied to working directory.

model_architecture: StrongCNNV6 (tri-branch Conv1d stem kernels 7/11/15 -> concat -> LayerNorm -> 1x1 proj to 320; 4 depthwise-separable residual blocks with SE(reduction=4), GELU, LayerNorm, Dropout 0.15, stochastic depth up to 0.1, dilations 1/2/4/8 with kernels 5/7/7/7; head: GMP+GAP concat 640 -> Dropout 0.35 -> Linear 1; reverse-complement aware encoder 5-channel one-hot length 600)
data_representation: One-hot DNA encoder (lowercase, map non-ACGT to 'n'), pad/crop to length 600. Channels: [A,C,G,T,N] (5). Reverse-complement augmentation (p=0.5) applied only during training. Data loader returns tensors shaped (B, C, L).

model_architecture: Logistic Regression (L2-penalized, liblinear solver) on flattened one-hot nucleotide features (gene 50×7 + miRNA 26×7 + length scalar)
data_representation: One-hot nucleotide encoding with padding. Gene sequences (fixed length 50) are normalized to A/C/G/T/U/N; invalid chars -> N. MiRNA (noncodingRNA) sequences are normalized similarly, truncated/padded to the max observed length across train/val (ncrna_max_len from data). Padding character '-' gets its own channel. Alphabet = [A, C, G, T, U, N, -]; each position is 7-dim one- hot. Features: concatenated flattened one-hots of gene (50×7) and miRNA (ncrna_max_len×7), plus a scalar miRNA length feature. Output arrays: float32 feature matrix; labels numeric_label as int8. Saved to /workspace/runs/ecstatic_movie_bumped/repr_baseline.npz with meta info in repr_info.txt.

model_architecture: Pipeline(StandardScaler -> CalibratedClassifierCV(base_estimator=LinearSVC(loss='hinge', class_weight='balanced', random_state=42, max_iter=5000), method='sigmoid', cv=3))
data_representation: Created k-mer frequency representation (k=3) with alphabet A,C,G,T,N. For each sample: clean sequences (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N), compute overlapping 3-mer frequencies for gene (len=50) and noncodingRNA (variable), normalized by max(1, num_kmers). Features: [gene_3mer_freqs(125, fixed lexicographic order), ncrna_3mer_freqs(125), gene_gc_content, ncrna_gc_content, gene_length, ncrna_length]. GC = (#G+#C)/length, lengths as integers. Saved float32 features and int8 labels (numeric_label) to repr_kmer.npz with ids and metadata repr_kmer_meta.json documenting alphabet/order/shapes. Paths: /workspace/runs/ecstatic_movie_bumped/repr_kmer.npz and repr_kmer_meta.json.

model_architecture: ExtraTreesClassifier (sklearn ensemble, class_weight='balanced')
data_representation: Created new basic representation per instructions. Sequences cleaned (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N). Built 4-mer index over alphabet A,C,G,T,N (5^4=625 kmers, lexicographic). For each sample: compute overlapping 4-mer counts for gene (len 50) and ncRNA, normalize by max(1, number_of_kmers) to get frequencies. Added GC content for each sequence ((G+C)/(length minus Ns, 0 if denom 0)) and lengths. Concatenated features: gene 4-mer freqs (625), ncRNA 4-mer freqs (625), gene_GC, ncRNA_GC, gene_len, ncRNA_len → total 1,254 dims. Saved float32 matrix/labels to repr_4mer.npz and metadata to repr_4mer_meta.json. Script: representation_4mer.py

model_architecture: Multinomial Naive Bayes on 62-dim composition features (1-mer/2-mer freqs, GC, length)
data_representation: Implemented basic composition features per instructions. Sequences are cleaned (uppercase, U→T, non- ACGT→N). For each sample: compute 1-mer frequencies over alphabet A,C,G,T,N for gene and ncRNA (5 each) and 2-mer frequencies over same alphabet (25 each), normalized by max(1, number_of_kmers) to get frequencies. Add GC content ((G+C)/(len−Ns), 0 if denom=0) and length for each sequence.

model_architecture: PyTorch dual-branch CNN with shared embedding; gene and miRNA Conv1d branches; feature interaction MLP classifier
data_representation: Created repr_cnn_pair.py to build CNN-ready tensors. Steps: clean sequences (uppercase, U→T, non- ACGT→N), map A/C/G/T/N→0/1/2/3/4, pad id=5. Gene padded/truncated to 50, miRNA padded/truncated to max length (computed 26 for this dataset). Auxiliary features per sample: gene_gc, mirna_gc, mirna_len, seed_complement_count (reverse-complement seed positions 2-8 count; if seed<4, count=0). Saves npz with keys gene_ids (N,50), mirna_ids (N,mirna_max_len), aux_features (N,4 float32), labels (int8), ids, metadata JSON (vocab, pad_id, mirna_max_len, feature order). Generated repr_cnn_pair_train.npz and repr_cnn_pair_val.npz using mirna_max_len=26.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on transformer embeddings
data_representation: Created transformer-based embedding representation (representation_nt_embed.py). Steps: clean sequences (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→A), tokenize with HF model InstaDeepAI/nucleotide- transformer-v2-50m-multi-species (trust_remote_code=True), batch encode on GPU (batch_size=128), mean-pool hidden states over non-padding tokens. For each sample, features = [gene_emb (512), mirna_emb (512), abs_diff (512), prod (512), aux scalars: gene_gc, mirna_gc, mirna_len, seed_complement_count] → total 2052 dims float32. Saved to repr_nt_embed.npz with train_features, val_features, labels, ids, and meta JSON (model/tokenizer names, hidden_size=512, pooling=mean_nonpadding, feature layout). Deterministic order aligned to train.csv/validation.csv split v1.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on paired feature vectors
data_representation: Built paired feature representation via paired_features.py. Cleaning: uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N. Gene length assumed 50 but length computed on cleaned seq. Features concatenated float32: (1) gene 4-mer frequency over alphabet A,C,G,T,N (625 dims, overlapping kmers, normalized by max(1,num_kmers)), (2) miRNA 4-mer frequency (625 dims, same normalization), (3) gene GC content, (4) miRNA GC content, (5) gene length, (6) miRNA length, (7) pairing stats from sliding reverse- complement miRNA along gene: best_total_comp_count, best_total_comp_frac, best_contig_match_len, best_seed_comp_count (positions 2-8), min_seed_mismatches (7 - best_seed_comp_count if miRNA len≥8 else 0), best_seed_contig_match_len, comp_frac_3prime (positions 13-16), global_max_contig_match_len. Labels numeric_label kept as int64. Saved to repr_paired_xgb.npz with JSON meta documenting feature order.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on paired_plus features (tree_method=gpu_hist with gpu_predictor fallback to hist/cpu)
data_representation: Built new paired_features_plus.py derived from iteration 6 with expanded wobble-aware pairing features. Cleaning: uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N. Features (1275 dims): gene 4-mer frequencies over A,C,G,T,N (625, normalized by max(1,num_kmers)), miRNA 4-mer frequencies (625), GC content (gene, miRNA), lengths (gene, miRNA), pairing stats (21): WC-only and WC+GU wobble aggregates while sliding rc-miRNA across gene. Aggregates include best_total_comp_count/frac, best_contig_match_len, best_seed_comp_count, min_seed_mismatches (7-best_seed_comp if seed len>=8 else 0), best_seed_contig_match_len, comp_frac_3prime (positions 13-16, WC), global_max_contig_match_len (WC), wobble analogs (_wcgu variants), offsets of best WC/WCGU alignments and seed alignments (0-based earliest tie-break), average comp fractions over shifts (avg_wc_comp_frac, avg_wcgu_comp_frac). Meta JSON stores feature_names (order), num_features, alphabet, k, pairing_feature_names. build_features returns features array, labels (label or numeric_label), ids, meta; also CLI to export npz if needed.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary:logistic classifier on 2060-d hybrid embedding+pairing features
data_representation: Created representation_hybrid_embed_pair.py that builds 2060-dim hybrid features per sample: gene and noncodingRNA sequences cleaned (upper, U→T, non-ACGT→A); transformer embeddings from InstaDeepAI/nucleotide-transformer-v2-50m-multi-species via mean pooling over non-padding tokens for gene and miRNA (512 dims each); derived abs_diff and product (512 each); pairing stats from paired_features.py (8 metrics); GC content and lengths for gene/miRNA (4). Batch encoding on GPU if available (batch_size default 128) using torch.no_grad float32. Script loads train.csv/validation.csv deterministically, saves NPZ with train_features, val_features, labels, ids, and JSON meta describing feature order/model/pooling/dims.

model_architecture: 2D CNN on interaction tensor (13x26x50) + auxiliary scalars: Conv2d(13,64,3,pad1)->BN->ReLU- >Conv2d(64,64,3,pad1)->BN->ReLU->MaxPool2d(2x2)->Conv2d(64,128,3,pad1)->BN->ReLU- >Conv2d(128,128,3,pad1)->BN->ReLU->MaxPool2d(2x2)->Conv2d(128,256,3,pad1)->BN->ReLU- >AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1))->Flatten(256)->concat aux(3)->MLP 259->128->ReLU->Dropout(0.3)->64->ReLU->Dropout(0.2)->1 (BCEWithLogits)
data_representation: Implemented interaction matrix representation (representation_interaction_matrix.py). Steps: load train.csv/validation.csv, clean sequences (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N), truncate/pad gene to length 50 and miRNA to max_len 26 with N. Per-sample tensor uint8 shape (13,26,50) channels: gene one-hot (A,C,G,T,N) broadcast, miRNA one-hot broadcast, wc_match, wobble_match, seed_mask (miRNA positions 1–7). Aux features float32: gene_GC, mirna_GC (ignoring Ns), mirna_length pre-padding. Saved npz: train_features, val_features, train_aux, val_aux, train_labels, val_labels, train_ids, val_ids. Meta JSON documents channel order, shapes, padding/truncation rules, aux order. Outputs: interaction_features.npz, interaction_meta.json.

model_architecture: CNN with residual SE attention on interaction matrices: input 13×26×50 tensor plus 3 aux scalars. Stem Conv2d(13→64,k3,p1)+BN+ReLU. Stage1: ResBlock64 [Conv k3 p1→BN→ReLU→Conv k3 p1→BN]+identity, SE(64→16→64, sigmoid), ReLU. MaxPool2d(2×2). Stage2: Conv2d(64→128,k3,p1)+BN+ReLU, ResBlock128 with SE(128→32→128), ReLU. MaxPool2d(2×2). Stage3: Conv2d(128→256,k3,p1)+BN+ReLU, ResBlock256 with SE(256→64→256), ReLU. AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1))→Flatten(256). Concatenate aux scalars to 259. MLP
data_representation: Re-used interaction-matrix representation from iteration 9: gene length padded/truncated to 50, miRNA length padded/truncated to 26 (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N, pad with N). Produce a 13×26×50 tensor per sample with channel order [gene_onehot_A, gene_onehot_C, gene_onehot_G, gene_onehot_T, gene_onehot_N, mirna_onehot_A, mirna_onehot_C, mirna_onehot_G, mirna_onehot_T, mirna_onehot_N, wc_match, wobble_match, seed_mask]; seed region is miRNA positions 1–7 (0-based inclusive). Aux scalars (float32) are [gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_length_pre_padding]. Stored/loaded via interaction_features.npz and interaction_meta.json; features dtype uint8, labels int8, ids str.

model_architecture: Dual-branch hybrid: CNN on 13×26×50 interaction tensor + MLP on 1275-d paired_plus features. CNN: Conv2d 13→64 k3 p1 - BN - ReLU; Conv2d 64→64 k3 p1 - BN - ReLU - MaxPool2d(2,2); Conv2d 64→128 k3 p1 - BN - ReLU; Conv2d 128→128 k3 p1 - BN - ReLU - MaxPool2d(2,2); Conv2d 128→256 k3 p1 - BN - ReLU; AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1)) → Flatten (256). MLP: Linear 1275→512 → ReLU → Dropout(0.3) → Linear 512→256 → ReLU → Dropout(0.2). Concatenate to 512 → Head: Linear 512→128 → ReLU → Dropout(0.2) → Linear 128→1 (logit).
data_representation: On-the-fly hybrid representation. For each sample: gene and miRNA sequences are uppercased, U→T, non-ACGT→N. Gene is padded/truncated to 50 nt; miRNA to 26 nt. Interaction tensor (float32, shape 13×26×50) channels: 5 gene one-hots (A,C,G,T,N) broadcast over miRNA length, 5 miRNA one-hots broadcast over gene length, Watson-Crick match mask, GU wobble match mask, seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7). Paired_plus feature vector (float32, length 1275): gene 4-mer freqs (625), miRNA 4-mer freqs (625), GC contents (gene, miRNA), lengths (gene, miRNA), wobble-aware pairing stats (WC and WC+GU counts/fracs/contigs/offsets/seed/3′/averages; 21 values). StandardScaler fit on training paired_plus features only (float32); same scaler applied to train/val. Dataset returns (interaction tensor, scaled paired_plus vector, label).

model_architecture: Ensemble of two shared-input CNNs on interaction tensors: (A) Base InteractionCNN (Conv blocks 64/64→MaxPool, 128/128→MaxPool, 256→AdaptiveAvgPool→Flatten→concat 3 aux→MLP 259→128→Dropout0.3→64→Dropout0.2→1 logit). (B) SE-augmented InteractionCNN (Conv13→64 stem, ResBlock64+SE→Pool, Conv128→ResBlock128+SE→Pool, Conv256→ResBlock256+SE→AdaptiveAvgPool→Flatten→concat 3 aux→MLP 259→128→Dropout0.3→64→Dropout0.2→1 logit). Ensemble prediction = average sigmoid probabilities.
data_representation: Interaction-matrix tensor built on-the-fly: gene and miRNA normalized (upper, U→T, non-ACGT→N), padded/truncated to 50 (gene) and 26 (miRNA). Channels (13) ordered: gene one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), miRNA one-hot (5), Watson-Crick match, wobble match, seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7). Tensor shape (13, 26, 50). Auxiliary features (3): gene GC content, miRNA GC content, miRNA original length. Implemented in representation_interaction_matrix.py with build_interaction_tensor.

model_architecture: HuggingFace AutoModelForSequenceClassification using InstaDeepAI/nucleotide- transformer-v2-50m-multi-species encoder, fully fine-tuned, with custom head: CLS hidden -> Linear(hidden_size→256) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(256→1), problem_type=single_label_classification (BCEWithLogits)
data_representation: On-the-fly tokenized gene–miRNA pairs using the HF tokenizer for InstaDeepAI/nucleotide- transformer-v2-50m-multi-species. Sequences are cleaned (uppercased, U→T, non-ACGT→N). Tokenization uses text/text_pair (gene, mirna) to form gene [SEP] miRNA with tokenizer-managed special tokens (supports [CLS]). token_type_ids denote segments (gene=0, miRNA=1). Dynamic per-batch padding via tokenizer.pad(return_tensors='pt'); attention_mask from tokenizer. Truncate to max_length=80. Labels kept as floats under key 'labels'; ids preserved. Implemented Dataset (OnTheFlyPairDataset), collator (PairDataCollator), tokenizer builder in data_representation.py; ordering matches CSV rows.

model_architecture: Dual-encoder cross-attention Transformer (d_model=96, vocab_size=6, pad_idx=5) with learned positional encodings; separate 2-layer TransformerEncoders (heads=4, ffn=192, dropout=0.1) for gene (L=50) and miRNA (L=26); bidirectional cross-attention (gene→miRNA and miRNA→gene, MHA heads=4, dim=96); pooled means of gene, miRNA, cross-gene, cross-miRNA outputs concatenated with 4 aux scalars → MLP 388→256→128→1 with ReLU and dropout 0.2.
data_representation: Created data_representation.py implementing on-the-fly token+mask representation with vocab A,C,G,T,N→0..4, pad=5; fixed lengths gene=50, miRNA=26. Sequences cleaned (uppercase, U→T, others→N). Dataset returns gene_ids, mirna_ids, gene_mask, mirna_mask, aux scalars (gene_gc, mirna_gc, mirna_length, seed_complement_count), id, and label if present. Collate stacks tensors; metadata JSON saved with vocab, pad_id, lengths, aux order.

model_architecture: InteractionCNN (base, no SE) with interaction-matrix input
data_representation: On-the-fly interaction matrix (copied representation_interaction_matrix.py from iteration_12). For each sample, build a 13×26×50 tensor plus 3 aux scalars: - Channels (first dimension): gene one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), miRNA one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), Watson-Crick match, wobble match, seed mask. - Gene preprocessing: uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N, truncate/pad right to length 50 with N. - miRNA preprocessing: uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N, truncate/pad right to length 26 with N. - Seed mask: positions miRNA indices 1-7 (0-based: 1..7) set to 1, rest 0; broadcast across gene length. - WC match channel: 1 where gene base complements miRNA base at position, else 0 (A-T, T-A, C-G, G-C). Wobble channel: 1 where (G,U/T) pairing. - Aux scalars: gene GC content, miRNA GC content, miRNA length before padding. No NPZ precomputation; dataset/dataloader builds tensors on-the-fly.

model_architecture: Ensemble of two InteractionCNN bases (seeds 42,1337) + two SE-InteractionCNN variants (seeds 24,77).
data_representation: Using on-the-fly interaction-matrix representation. Gene and miRNA sequences are uppercased, U→T, non-ACGT→N. Gene truncated/padded right to length 50 with N; miRNA truncated/padded right to length 26 with N. Build tensor of shape (13,26,50): channels ordered gene one-hots A,C,G,T,N (5), miRNA one-hots A,C,G,T,N (5), Watson-Crick match, wobble match (G–T/T–G), seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7 broadcast over gene). Auxiliary scalars: gene GC content, miRNA GC content, original miRNA length before padding. Labels and ids preserved. Dataset constructs tensors on-the-fly (no precomputed NPZ).

model_architecture: Bagged ensemble of 6 CNNs on interaction tensor: three InteractionCNN (iter16 base) with seeds {42,1337,2024} and three SE-InteractionCNN (iter16 SE variant) with seeds {24,77,31415}. Shared head MLP 259→128→ReLU→Dropout→64→ReLU→Dropout→1 with dropout 0.35 then 0.25. Loss: focal loss (gamma=2.0, alpha=0.5) if available, else BCEWithLogitsLoss with label_smoothing=0.05.
data_representation: Interaction-matrix on-the-fly (copied from iteration_16/representation_interaction_matrix.py). Sequences cleaned: uppercase, U→T, other→N. Gene length 50, miRNA length 26 with right padding. Tensor channels: [gene one-hot A,C,G,T,N (5), miRNA one-hot A,C,G,T,N (5), Watson-Crick match map, wobble match map, seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7 broadcast across gene)]. Aux scalars: gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_original_length. Padding/ordering identical to iter16 implementation.

model_architecture: Super-ensemble of interaction CNN models (base and SE variants) from iterations 16 and 17; 10 total checkpoints averaged at inference (base seeds 42,1337,2024 and SE seeds 24,77,31415 from iter17 plus base seeds 42,1337 and SE seeds 24,77 from iter16). Uses representation_interaction_matrix (13x26x50 tensor + 3 aux scalars) and same model classes as iteration 17.
data_representation: Reused interaction-matrix representation from iteration 17. Implemented in representation_interaction_matrix.py (copied from iteration_17). Sequences cleaned (uppercase, U→T, others→N), gene padded/truncated to 50, miRNA to 26 with N. Tensor shape (13, 26, 50) channels: gene one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), miRNA one-hot (5), Watson-Crick match, wobble match, seed mask positions 1–7. Auxiliary scalars: gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_original_length. IDs/labels preserved.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on rinalmo-mega embeddings + wobble-aware paired_plus features
data_representation: New representation built per instructions: rinalmo-mega embeddings + wobble-aware paired_plus features. Script: representation_rinalmo_embed.py. Steps: clean sequences uppercase U→T; for embedding convert T→U; map non-ACGU to N (tokenizer supports N). Tokenizer: multimolecule.tokenisers.rna.RnaTokenizer.from_pretrained('multimolecule/rinalmo-mega'); model: AutoModel.from_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=True), hidden_size=640, using GPU fp16 autocast. For each sample, gene and miRNA encoded separately with padding; last_hidden_state mean-pooled over attention_mask to fixed 640-d vectors. Paired_plus features from paired_features_plus.py (copied from iteration_7) give 1275 dims. Feature vector = [gene_emb (640), mirna_emb (640), |gene-mirna| (640), gene*mirna (640), paired_plus (1275)] => total 3835 dims, float32. Labels numeric_label, ids preserved. Saved to repr_rinalmo_embed.npz with train_features, val_features aligned to train.csv/validation.csv; meta saved to repr_rinalmo_embed_meta.json (model_name, hidden_size, feature_order, batch_size=32, paired_plus_num_features=1275, allow_n=True). Batch embedding ran on GPU. Outputs confirmed shapes: train (6533,3835), val (1660,3835). Files created: representation_rinalmo_embed.py, paired_features_plus.py, repr_rinalmo_embed.npz, repr_rinalmo_embed_meta.json.

model_architecture: CNN with depthwise-separable residual blocks: stem Conv2d 15→64 (k3,p1)+BN+SiLU; DS-Res block = depthwise conv (k3,p1,groups=ch)→BN→SiLU→pointwise conv→BN→SiLU→SE (gap→fc ch_out→ch_out/4→SiLU→fc→sigmoid) with residual/project. Stages: S1 two blocks 64→64, MaxPool2d(2,2); S2 two blocks (64→128 proj, 128→128), MaxPool2d(2,2); S3 one block 128→192 proj; S4 one block 192→256 proj; AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1,1)→flatten (256); concat aux(3)→259; MLP head 259→128→SiLU→Dropout0.3→64→SiLU→Dropout0.2→1 logit. BCEWithLogitsLoss label_smoothing=0.05.
data_representation: Created representation_interaction_positional.py that builds tensors on-the-fly without precomputing. Sequences are uppercased, U->T, other->N; padded/truncated to gene length 50 and miRNA length 26. Output tensor shape (15,26,50) with channels: gene one-hots A/C/G/T/N (5), miRNA one-hots (5), Watson-Crick match, wobble match, seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7 broadcast), gene_pos positional channel (normalized 0..1 along gene, broadcast over miRNA axis), and mirna_pos positional channel (normalized 0..1 along miRNA, broadcast over gene axis). Auxiliary scalars: gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_original_length. Returned as (tensor15, aux3).

model_architecture: ConvNeXt-style CNN for 15×26×50 tensor plus 3 aux scalars. Stem: Conv2d 15→96 k7 p3 s1 + LayerNorm (channels_last) + GELU. Stages with ConvNeXt blocks (depthwise k7 p3 groups=channels → LayerNorm → pointwise Linear expand×4 → GELU → pointwise Linear, residual with linear drop_path up to 0.1): Stage1 width 96, 2 blocks then downsample Conv2d 96→192 stride 2; Stage2 width 192, 2 blocks then downsample Conv2d 192→384 stride 2; Stage3 width 384, 3 blocks. Global avg pool → 384-d, concat 3 aux → 387-d. Head MLP: 387→256 GELU Dropout0.3 → 256→64 GELU Dropout0.2 → 64→1 logit.
data_representation: Reused positional interaction tensor from iteration 20 via representation_interaction_positional.py. For each sample, build on-the-fly a 15×26×50 float32 tensor: gene one-hot (A/C/G/T/N, 5 ch) broadcast over miRNA length; miRNA one-hot (5 ch) broadcast over gene length; Watson–Crick match channel; wobble match channel; seed mask channel (positions 0–6 across miRNA); gene_pos channel (0..1 across gene length, broadcast over miRNA); miRNA_pos channel (0..1 across miRNA length, broadcast over gene). Padding/truncation: gene max 50, miRNA max 26, fill with N, truncate excess. Aux features (3 floats): gene GC content (pre-padding), miRNA GC content (pre-padding), miRNA original length. Channel order unchanged from iteration 20.

model_architecture: Ensemble of pre-trained CNNs (13-channel interaction models from iter16/17 meta_superensemble + 15-channel positional depthwise-separable CNNs from iter20)
data_representation: Implemented on-the-fly dual representations in mega_representation.py. Interaction tensor 13-channel (50x26x13): gene one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), miRNA one-hot A/C/G/T/N (5), WC match, wobble match, seed mask (miRNA positions 1–7). Aux scalars: gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_length. Positional variant 15-channel adds gene_pos and mirna_pos channels (normalized 0–1). Dataset/Dataloader build tensors per batch from CSV, keep ids as strings; supports numeric_label fallback. No NPZ used.

model_architecture: Weighted ensemble of pretrained CNNs: interaction family (13-channel CNN/SE from iterations 16/17) and positional depthwise CNN family (15-channel from iteration 20), combined via optimized convex weights; no new training.
data_representation: Reused dual interaction representations from iteration 22 (mega_representation.py). Two on-the-fly encodings with fixed padding/truncation: gene length 50, miRNA length 26, uppercase conversion with U→T, others→N, ids preserved as strings. (1) 13-channel interaction tensor: gene/miRNA one-hot (A,C,G,T,N), Watson-Crick match channel, wobble match channel, seed mask channel; with 3 auxiliary scalars (gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_length). (2) 15-channel positional tensor: same as (1) plus gene_pos and mirna_pos channels; with the same 3 auxiliary scalars. DataLoader collate keeps ids as strings.

model_architecture: Stacked meta-learner over base probability features: primary model = scikit-learn LogisticRegression (binary, L2), optional secondary candidate = XGBoost binary classifier
data_representation: Stacking features built from base model probabilities: p17 from iteration17 interaction ensemble, p20 from iteration20 positional depthwise CNN ensemble, and p_opt from iteration23 optimized ensemble. Scripts run base inferences on train.csv/validation.csv to produce preds_iter17_train/val.csv, preds_iter20_train/val.csv, preds_opt_train/val.csv. build_stack_features.py merges by id with labels to create stack_features_train.csv and stack_features_val.csv with columns [id, p17, p20, p_opt, label]. No additional preprocessing or standardization applied; raw probability features used.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier (tree_method='gpu_hist' fallback 'hist')
data_representation: Built representation_nt250_pair.py using InstaDeepAI/nucleotide-transformer-v2-250m-multi-species embeddings + paired_plus. Cleaning: uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N. Gene/miRNA tokenized separately (max_length=128), embedded with AutoModelForMaskedLM (trust_remote_code=True), hidden_states[-1] mean-pooled over attention_mask under fp16 autocast on GPU. Features = concat[g_emb, m_emb, |g-m|, g*m, paired_plus(k-mer+GC/len+WC/WCGU wobble stats)], float32. Batch size 32, num_workers 0, pin_memory when CUDA. Saved repr_nt250_pair.npz (train_features, val_features, train_labels, val_labels, train_ids, val_ids) and repr_nt250_pair_meta.json (model_name, hidden_size, paired_plus_dim, feature_layout, tokenizer_max_length, batch_size).

model_architecture: Weighted blending ensemble over four base ensembles (iter17 interaction ensemble, iter18 super ensemble, iter20 positional depthwise CNN ensemble, iter22 mega ensemble); final prediction = convex combination of their probabilities
data_representation: Reused dual on-the-fly interaction representations from iteration 22 (mega_representation.py): sequences cleaned uppercase, U→T, others→N; gene padded/truncated to 50, miRNA to 26. Produces two parallel tensors: (1) 13-channel interaction tensor combining gene one-hot (5), miRNA one-hot (5), Watson-Crick mask, wobble mask, seed mask; plus 3 auxiliary scalars (gene length, miRNA length, GC content). (2) 15-channel positional tensor with same channels plus gene_pos and mirna_pos channels; plus same 3 auxiliaries. Batch collate keeps ids as strings; padding rules preserved.

model_architecture: Calibration wrapper over existing blended ensemble (iteration 28) using scikit-learn IsotonicRegression on blended probability_1
data_representation: Reused dual on-the-fly representations from iteration 22 via mega_representation.py. Sequences are cleaned (uppercase, U→T, non-ACGT→N), truncated/padded to gene length 50 and miRNA length 26. Two tensors per sample: 13-channel interaction (gene one-hot 5ch, miRNA one-hot 5ch, WC match, wobble GT/TG, seed mask) and 15-channel positional version (adds gene_pos, mirna_pos). Auxiliary features: gene GC, miRNA GC, miRNA raw length. Collate builds inter13, inter15, aux stacks and preserves ids as strings; labels stacked when present. Padding/truncation rules preserved; ids preserved in order.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on meta-features (stacked probabilities + auxiliary GC/length scalars)
data_representation: Stacked meta-features built via stack_meta_features.py: for each row, merged four base ensemble probabilities (p17, p20, p22, p28) from iter17, iter20, iter22, iter28 inference scripts; computed auxiliary scalars using mega_representation (_clean_seq/_gc_content) capturing gene_GC, mirna_GC, and mirna_length (raw pre-padding). Created train_meta.csv and val_meta.csv with columns [id, p17, p20, p22, p28, gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_length, numeric_label], plus a 5-fold stratified fold column in train_meta for potential OOF evaluation. train.csv and validation.csv were untouched; predictions generated via copied training_artifacts_iterXX.

model_architecture: Rank-based weighted blending ensemble over five existing base ensembles (iter17 interaction ensemble, iter18 super-ensemble, iter20 positional depthwise CNN ensemble, iter22 mega-ensemble, iter28 blended ensemble); scoring uses normalized ranks of probability_1 and weighted average
data_representation: Dual on-the-fly interaction representation from iteration 22: (1) 13-channel interaction tensor: for each gene position (length 50, padded/truncated to 50) × miRNA position (length 26, padded/truncated to 26), channels encode base matching/complement rules and positional masks as in mega_representation.py. (2) 15-channel positional tensor: per-position features for gene (50) and miRNA (26) capturing one-hot bases, pairing masks, relative positions, loop/seed indicators as defined in mega_representation.py. (3) Auxiliary scalars: gene_GC, mirna_GC, mirna_length. Padding/truncation rules unchanged: gene fixed length 50, miRNA fixed length 26; pad with N/zero features when shorter, truncate when longer. Representations are built on-the-fly from raw sequences using mega_representation.py; no preprocessing files stored.

model_architecture: Probability-weighted blending ensemble over five existing base ensembles (iter17 interaction ensemble, iter18 super-ensemble, iter20 positional depthwise CNN ensemble, iter22 mega ensemble, iter28 blended ensemble). Final score = convex combination of their probability_1 outputs.
data_representation: Reused iteration22 dual interaction representation: for each sample, gene (length 50) and miRNA (length 26) are uppercased, truncated/padded with N. Encoded on-the-fly into (13,26,50) interaction tensor capturing base complementarity and pairwise features, and (15,26,50) positional tensor capturing position channels. Auxiliary scalar features: gene_GC fraction, mirna_GC fraction, mirna_length. All tensors float32; ids kept as strings in DataLoader. No new files created; mega_representation.py copied from iteration_22 for reuse.

model_architecture: 1D CNN: Input (batch,4,500) → Conv1d(4,64,k=7,pad=3) → ReLU → MaxPool1d(2) → Conv1d(64,128,k=5,pad=2) → ReLU → MaxPool1d(2) → Conv1d(128,256,k=5,pad=2) → ReLU → MaxPool1d(2) → AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) → Flatten → Dropout(0.3) → Linear(256,64) → ReLU → Dropout(0.3) → Linear(64,2) with CrossEntropyLoss on logits.
data_representation: Per-base one-hot encoding integrated into PyTorch Dataset (dataset.py). Sequences are truncated/padded to length 500, mapped A->[1,0,0,0], C->[0,1,0,0], G->[0,0,1,0], T->[0,0,0,1], others->[0,0,0,0]. Output tensor shape (4,500) channels-first. Dataset returns id, input tensor, gc_content, and optional integer label (negative=0, positive=1).

model_architecture: Calibrated linear SVM: LinearSVC(C=1.0, loss='squared_hinge', penalty='l2', dual=True, tol=1e-3, max_iter=5000, random_state=42) wrapped with CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=3, method='sigmoid', n_jobs=-1)

data_representation: Reuse existing ESM2 t36 3B embeddings from iteration 6: load features_esm3b.npz (numpy) and metadata features_esm3b.json. Do not alter featurization; if NPZ missing, regenerate with provided esm3b_embedding.py script (batch_size=1, GPU fp16). Use x_train, y_train, x_val, y_val stored inside features_esm3b.npz for modeling.

model_architecture: Two-model candidate sweep: (A) StandardScaler + KernelRidge with RBF kernel; (B) PyTorch MLP (input 2560 -> LayerNorm -> 512 GELU dropout0.1 -> 256 GELU dropout0.1 -> 1).
data_representation: Reuse ESM2 t36 3B embeddings saved in features_esm3b.npz (float32 arrays x_train, y_train, x_val, y_val), computed by averaging last 4 layers, mean-pooling non-special tokens, batch_size=1 (fp16 GPU). Labels unchanged.

model_architecture: Classical ML baseline: L2-regularized Logistic Regression on binary Morgan fingerprints (ECFP, radius 2, 2048 bits). Uses scikit-learn’s LogisticRegression with solver='saga', penalty='l2', class_weight='balanced'.
data_representation: Basic molecular representation: binary Morgan fingerprints (ECFP) with radius 2 and 2048 bits generated from SMILES via RDKit. Invalid SMILES (none expected) are mapped to zero vectors with mask recorded. Featurization script: featurize.py in working directory supports CSV → npz conversion, outputting X (fingerprints), valid_mask, optional labels/ids. Rationale: simplest, commonly used baseline representation for small molecules.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on 2048-bit radius-2 Morgan fingerprints
data_representation: Binary Morgan/ECFP fingerprints: radius=2, n_bits=2048, using smiles as input. Featurize via featurize.py exactly as in iteration 0; no changes. Labels unchanged (CLASS_EGFR).

model_architecture: RandomForestClassifier on RDKit MACCS (166-bit) fingerprints
data_representation: New representation: RDKit MACCS keys (166-bit) binary fingerprints. Featurizer script featurize_maccs.py reads CSV with id, smiles, optional CLASS_EGFR, computes MACCS (dropping first bit to keep 166 bits), invalid SMILES -> all-zero vector and valid_mask. Outputs npz with ids, X (float32), valid_mask, and labels if present. This MACCS featurization will be used for RandomForest in this iteration; existing ECFP remains untouched.

model_architecture: Logistic Regression classifier on RDKit 2D physicochemical descriptors; pipeline: column-mean imputation -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression(solver='saga') with class_weight='balanced'
data_representation: Created RDKit 2D physicochemical descriptor featurizer (featurize_descriptors.py). Extracts numeric descriptors (MolWt, MolLogP, TPSA, H-bond acceptors/donors, rotatable bonds, aromatic/aliphatic/saturated rings, FractionCSP3, heavy atoms, valence electrons, ring count, HallKierAlpha, Kappa1/2/3, etc.). Invalid SMILES -> zero vector and valid_mask=False. Outputs npz with ids, X (float32), valid_mask, labels (if present); accompanying JSON stores feature_names. NaNs to be column-mean imputed during preprocessing.

model_architecture: Model 1: LogisticRegression (saga, L2) on ECFP (radius=2, 2048 bits); Model 2: RandomForestClassifier on MACCS (166 bits); Ensemble: weighted average of probabilities (w∈{0.3,0.5,0.7} for LR weight).
data_representation: Dual molecular fingerprints. (1) ECFP: RDKit Morgan fingerprints, radius=2, 2048 bits, binary folded. Featurizer: featurize.py from iteration_0. (2) MACCS: RDKit MACCS keys, 166 bits, binary.

model_architecture: Three base models + weighted ensemble: (A) LogisticRegression (solver=saga, penalty=l2) on ECFP 2048-bit radius-2 fingerprints; class_weight='balanced'. (B) RandomForestClassifier on 166-bit MACCS keys with class_weight='balanced_subsample', max_features='sqrt', bootstrap=True. (C) Pipeline: SimpleImputer(strategy='mean') -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression(solver=saga, penalty∈{l1,l2}) on RDKit 2D descriptors; class_weight='balanced'. Ensemble: convex combination of base probabilities p_ens = w_ecfp*p_ecfp + w_maccs*p_maccs + w_desc*p_desc, weights on simplex grid step 0.1.
data_representation: Reuse three featurizers from prior iterations: (1) ECFP (Morgan radius=2, 2048 bits, binary) via featurize.py from iteration 4; (2) MACCS 166-bit binary keys via featurize_maccs.py from iteration 2; (3) RDKit 2D descriptor set via featurize_descriptors.py from iteration 3 with NaN handling. Apply them unchanged to both train and validation/test splits; keep outputs aligned with rows. No additional feature engineering or data exploration performed.

model_architecture: HuggingFace AutoModelForSequenceClassification fine-tuning of DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR (ChemBERTa) with num_labels=2, problem_type='single_label_classification', full model unfrozen, default dropout retained.
data_representation: ChemBERTa text featurization: use HuggingFace tokenizer from checkpoint DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR on SMILES strings with max_length=256, truncation=True, padding='max_length'. Tokenizer loaded via AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained. Datasets return input_ids, attention_mask, and labels when available. Code in data_representation.py.

model_architecture: Two-model ensemble: (1) Transformer: AutoModelForSequenceClassification using checkpoint DeepChem/ChemBERTa-10M-MTR (num_labels=2, full fine-tuning). (2) Classical baseline: LogisticRegression (saga, penalty='l2', class_weight='balanced') on 2048-bit ECFP (radius=2). Ensemble via weighted average p_ens = w*p_transformer + (1-w)*p_ecfp tuned on validation.
data_representation: ChemBERTa-10M-MTR tokenizer (max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True) for sequence inputs via data_representation.py; ECFP (Morgan radius=2, 2048-bit binary) via featurize.py for classical features.

model_architecture: Ensemble: (A) Transformer fine-tuned ChemBERTa-77M-MTR via AutoModelForSequenceClassification (num_labels=2) with focal-loss Trainer override; (B) ECFP LogisticRegression (saga, l2). Ensemble by weighted average of class-1 probs with weight search.
data_representation: Two representations: 1) Text SMILES to ChemBERTa-77M-MTR tokenizer (DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR), max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True, return_tensors for HF. Used for transformer fine-tuning. 2) ECFP: Morgan fingerprints radius=2, 2048-bit binary vectors from RDKit (featurize.py from prior iterations). Used for logistic regression.

model_architecture: Ensemble of (A) ChemBERTa-77M-MTR transformer classifier and (B) ECFP-based Logistic Regression; final prediction is weighted average of class-1 probabilities.
data_representation: Two parallel representations: 1) Text (ChemBERTa-77M-MTR): use DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR tokenizer with max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True. Training set is augmented per molecule with 5 random_smiles plus canonical SMILES (≈6× data); validation/test use canonical SMILES only. Tokenized inputs feed the transformer. 2) ECFP: Morgan fingerprints radius=2, 2048-bit binary from featurize.py (iteration 0 equivalent). Invalid SMILES produce a zero vector. These vectors feed a LogisticRegression model. Ensemble later combines model probabilities; representations themselves remain separate.

model_architecture: Ensemble: (A) ChemBERTa-77M-MTR fine-tuned classifier with focal loss; (B) ECFP Logistic Regression; ensemble via weighted average of probabilities.
data_representation: Re-use iteration 11 representations: (1) Text: ChemBERTa-77M-MTR tokenizer with max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True. Training data augmented on-the-fly with canonical SMILES plus 5 random SMILES variants per molecule; validation/test use canonical SMILES only (or canonical + TTA at inference). Tokenizer outputs input_ids and attention_mask. (2) ECFP: 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, binary) generated via the existing featurize.py from iteration 11. These two representations feed separate models (transformer and Logistic Regression) and are combined at ensemble time.

model_architecture: Two-model ensemble: (A) AutoModelForSequenceClassification from checkpoint ibm-research/MoLFormer- XL-both-10pct fine-tuned end-to-end (num_labels=2, problem_type='single_label_classification'); (B) LogisticRegression on 2048-bit ECFP (radius=2)
data_representation: Two parallel representations.

model_architecture: Ensemble: (A) ChemBERTa-77M-MTR classifier fine-tuned end-to-end; (B) Logistic Regression on ECFP r=2 (2048 bits); (C) Logistic Regression on ECFP r=3 (4096 bits); ensemble blend with simplex-grid weights.
data_representation: Three parallel representations: (1) Transformer branch using DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR tokenizer with SMILES sequences padded/truncated to max_length=256; training augments each molecule with canonical SMILES plus 5 random SMILES (6× expansion); validation/test use canonical (with optional TTA at inference). (2) ECFP r=2: 2048-bit binary Morgan fingerprints (radius=2) via featurize.py; invalid SMILES -> zero vector with valid_mask flag. (3) ECFP r=3: 4096-bit binary Morgan fingerprints (radius=3) via featurize_ecfp_r3.py; invalid SMILES -> zero vector with valid_mask flag. Save features/masks/labels/ids in npz aligned to input CSV order.

model_architecture: Ensemble of three logistic regression classifiers (solver=saga, penalty=L2, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=8000, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42) trained separately on different molecular featurizations: (A) ECFP radius 2, 2048 bits; (B) ECFP radius 3, 4096 bits; (C) pipeline of SimpleImputer(mean) → StandardScaler → LogisticRegression on RDKit 2D descriptors.
data_representation: Re-use existing featurizers: - ECFP radius 2, 2048 bits (float32) via featurize.py from iteration_14; invalid SMILES -> zero vector, valid_mask saved. - ECFP radius 3, 4096 bits (float32) via featurize_ecfp_r3.py from iteration_14; invalid SMILES -> zero vector, valid_mask saved. - RDKit 2D descriptors via featurize_descriptors.py from iteration_3; outputs numeric descriptor array plus valid_mask; NaNs will be mean-imputed later in model pipeline. No new featurization; just load and reuse these scripts for train/val/test processing.

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier (tree_method='gpu_hist' fallback 'hist'), objective='binary:logistic', eval_metric='aucpr', trained on concatenated ECFP r2 (2048) + ECFP r3 (4096) + RDKit 2D descriptors
data_representation: Concatenate three feature blocks per molecule (float32): (1) ECFP radius 2 (2048 bits) from featurize.py; (2) ECFP radius 3 (4096 bits) from featurize_ecfp_r3.py; (3) RDKit 2D descriptors from featurize_descriptors.py with NaNs imputed using training-set column means. Order: r2 bits, then r3 bits, then descriptors. Invalid SMILES yield zero vectors for all blocks; descriptor NaNs filled later. No label transforms.

model_architecture: Blended logistic-ensemble and XGBoost classifier
data_representation: We will reuse the three-block molecular featurization from iteration 16/15: (1) ECFP (radius=2, 2048 bits) counted/hashed to binary/int as float32; (2) ECFP (radius=3, 4096 bits) similarly; (3) RDKit 2D descriptor vector (standard RDKit descriptor set) as float32. Block order is fixed: r2 bits, then r3 bits, then descriptors. Invalid SMILES result in zero vectors for all blocks. Descriptor NaNs are imputed with the column means computed on the training set and stored for reuse. For XGBoost, the three blocks are concatenated into one float32 feature matrix. For the logistic ensemble, each block is used separately by its own logistic regression model; their predicted probabilities are later combined via learned simplex weights.

model_architecture: LightGBM binary classifier (gbdt, GPU if available) on concatenated features: ECFP radius2 (2048 bits) || ECFP radius3 (4096 bits) || RDKit 2D descriptors (float32, NaNs imputed with train means)
data_representation: Concatenate three feature blocks per molecule in order: (1) ECFP radius 2, 2048 bits from featurize.py; (2) ECFP radius 3, 4096 bits from featurize_ecfp_r3.py; (3) RDKit 2D descriptors from featurize_descriptors.py with NaNs imputed using training-set column means. All features cast to float32; descriptor means saved for reuse. Final vector length = 2048 + 4096 + num_descriptors.

model_architecture: Two-branch ensemble: (A) LightGBM binary classifier on concatenated features (ECFP r2 2048 + ECFP r3 4096 + RDKit 2D descriptors), boosting='gbdt'; (B) Three LogisticRegression (solver='saga', penalty='l2', class_weight='balanced') per-block (r2, r3, descriptors with imputer+scaler), combined via simplex weights; final blend p_final = alpha * p_lgbm + (1 - alpha) * p_log_ens.
data_representation: Reused three-block featurization from iteration 18: (1) ECFP radius 2, 2048-bit binary from featurize.py; (2) ECFP radius 3, 4096-bit binary from featurize_ecfp_r3.py; (3) RDKit 2D descriptors via featurize_descriptors.py with NaNs imputed by training-set column means. Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors; descriptor NaNs imputed with stored train means. For tree model concatenate r2||r3||descriptors; for logistic models use each block separately.

model_architecture: CatBoostClassifier (ordered boosting) on concatenated features r2||r3||descriptors; task_type='GPU' if available else CPU
data_representation: Concatenate three numeric feature blocks in order r2 || r3 || descriptors: (1) ECFP radius 2, 2048-bit binary fingerprints from featurize.py; (2) ECFP radius 3, 4096-bit binary fingerprints from featurize_ecfp_r3.py; (3) RDKit 2D descriptors from featurize_descriptors.py. Compute descriptor column means on training set and impute NaNs with these means for both train and inference. Cast all features to float32 before modeling. Preserve the saved descriptor means for inference.

model_architecture: LightGBM ensemble (5 seeds) on concatenated features (ECFP r2 2048b + ECFP r3 4096b + RDKit 2D descriptors)
data_representation: Reuse iteration 18 concatenated features: ECFP radius 2 (2048-bit, binary) via featurize.py, concatenated with ECFP radius 3 (4096-bit, binary) via featurize_ecfp_r3.py, concatenated with RDKit 2D descriptors via featurize_descriptors.py. Order: r2 || r3 || descriptors. Compute descriptor column means on train set for imputation; impute NaNs with these means for train/val/test. Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors for fingerprints and descriptors, still imputed/scaled consistently. Cast all features to float32.

model_architecture: Ensemble of pretrained LightGBM and XGBoost classifiers; final probability = w*p_lgbm + (1-w)*p_xgb
data_representation: Concatenate three blocks per molecule, all float32: (1) ECFP radius-2, 2048-bit binary from featurize.py; (2) ECFP radius-3, 4096-bit binary from featurize_ecfp_r3.py; (3) RDKit 2D descriptor vector from featurize_descriptors.py. No scaling on fingerprints; descriptor block imputed per model using its stored mean vector (separate means for LightGBM and XGBoost). Final feature order is r2 || r3 || descriptors.

model_architecture: Ridge regression (linear model) on fixed-position amino-acid one-hot features
data_representation: One-hot encode each amino acid per sequence position. For every sequence (length 341), split into characters and apply a fixed alphabet of 20 standard amino acids (A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y). Use scikit-learn OneHotEncoder with predefined categories per position (handle_unknown='ignore') to produce a sparse matrix of shape (n_samples, 341*20). Numeric_label remains the regression target. Script: data_representation.py (fits encoder on train sequences, transforms train/val to sparse matrices, saves encoder and joblib datasets).

model_architecture: Scikit-learn GradientBoostingRegressor within a simple pipeline (no scaling), using random_state=42 and GridSearchCV (cv=5, scoring='neg_mean_squared_error').
data_representation: AA composition (20 normalized counts) + dipeptide composition (400 normalized counts) using alphabet [A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y]; counts normalized by length and L-1; non-standard AAs ignored. Features saved as dense numpy arrays via joblib: features_composition/train_features.joblib and val_features.joblib with feature_config.json recording alphabet order.

model_architecture: ElasticNetCV regression on 320-d pooled ESM-2 (facebook/esm2_t6_8M_UR50D) embeddings
data_representation: ESM-2 sequence embeddings using facebook/esm2_t6_8M_UR50D. For each sequence, tokenize with the ESM2 tokenizer, run the model in eval mode (GPU if available), take last hidden states, mean-pool over residues excluding CLS/EOS tokens to yield a 320-dim vector. Embeddings for train/val saved as .pt with ids and embedding tensors; embedding_config.json records model id, pooling, dim, batch size, and device. Script esm_embed.py batches sequences (default batch_size=12), uses torch.no_grad(), falls back to replacing non-alpha chars with X if tokenization fails.

model_architecture: Linear ElasticNetCV with k-mer StandardScaler pipeline
data_representation: Implemented 3-mer frequency bag-of-words features over 20 standard amino acids (A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y). Generated all 20^3=8000 tri-peptide combinations in fixed alphabetical order. For each sequence, slid a window of size 3 across the full length, counting only windows with all-standard AAs; counts for each 3-mer were divided by (L-2) to yield frequency features. Stored as sparse CSR matrices in train_features.joblib and val_features.joblib; feature order and settings recorded in feature_config.json (alphabet, k=3, kmer_list, normalize_by=L-2, notes). Files created in working directory.

model_architecture: scikit-learn Pipeline(StandardScaler() -> KernelRidge(kernel='rbf'))
data_representation: Generated new embeddings using facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D. Mean-pooled last hidden states over non-special tokens to produce 640-d vectors per sequence. Used torch.no_grad() and model.eval() with GPU if available, batch size 4. Saved outputs to features_esm2_t30/train_embeddings.pt and val_embeddings.pt with ids, plus embedding_config.json documenting model_id, pooling, dim, batch_size, device.

model_architecture: scikit-learn Pipeline: StandardScaler() -> SVR(kernel='rbf') with custom Spearman scorer and 5-fold CV (KFold, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
data_representation: Prepared new embedding pipeline script embed_t12.py to generate mean-pooled last-hidden-state ESM-2 embeddings (facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D). Script tokenizes sequences, uses model.eval() with torch.no_grad(), runs on GPU if available (batch_size=12), excludes special tokens, pools over remaining positions, and saves train/val embeddings (.pt with ids, tensors) plus embedding_config.json describing model_id, pooling, dim, batch_size, and device. Ready to run on existing train.csv/validation.csv without modifying them.

model_architecture: scikit-learn Pipeline: StandardScaler -> SVR(kernel='rbf')
data_representation: Mean-pooled last-layer token embeddings from facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D (H=1280), excluding BOS/CLS/EOS/SEP/PAD tokens, computed with torch.no_grad(), model.eval(), batch_size=1 on GPU if available. Outputs: train_embeddings.pt and val_embeddings.pt storing tensors and id lists, plus embedding_config.json documenting model_id, pooling, dim, batch_size, and device.

model_architecture: Meta-learner: scikit-learn Pipeline(StandardScaler -> RidgeCV)
data_representation: Meta-features ensemble: For each sample, compute three base-model predictions and stack into a 3-D feature vector [pred_base0, pred_base5, pred_base6]. - pred_base0: iteration_0 one-hot positional RidgeCV; sequences length 341 encoded via saved OneHotEncoder, then RidgeCV predicts. - pred_base5: iteration_5 SVR on ESM2-t12 mean-pooled embeddings; reuse precomputed train/val embeddings aligned to ids. - pred_base6: iteration_6 SVR on ESM2-t33 mean-pooled embeddings; reuse precomputed train/val embeddings aligned to ids. Saved artifacts: meta_features_train.joblib and meta_features_val.joblib (dict with X, y, ids) plus meta_features_config.json documenting base models and paths. random_state=42 everywhere.

model_architecture: RandomForestRegressor on 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius=2). Classical ensemble baseline, handles small datasets, captures non-linear relationships, robust to scaling.
data_representation: Morgan/ECFP fingerprint baseline: RDKit-generated circular fingerprints with radius=2 and 2048 bits from SMILES. Conversion script `representation.py` featurizes CSVs to numpy arrays (npz), supports optional target column. This is the basic, commonly used molecular representation for a classical ML baseline.

model_architecture: StandardScaler(with_mean=False) + ElasticNet
data_representation: Created MACCS 166-bit featurizer using RDKit. Script maccs_representation.py reads CSV with smiles (and optional target), converts each SMILES to RDKit MACCS keys (GetMACCSKeysFingerprint), drops the first unused bit to yield 166-length vector per molecule, stacks into numpy array X (shape [n_samples, 166]), optionally includes y, and saves npz plus meta JSON. This representation will be used consistently for train/validation/inference; no Morgan features involved.

model_architecture: ExtraTreesRegressor on RDKit 2D descriptor features (no scaler)
data_representation: Implemented RDKit 2D descriptor featurization (descriptors.py). Script reads a CSV with smiles (and optional target), computes all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors via MolecularDescriptorCalculator, drops constant or all-NaN columns, fills remaining NaNs with column means, and saves X (and y if present) to npz plus meta JSON containing kept indices/names and fill means. The same meta can be reused to apply identical preprocessing for train/val/inference.

model_architecture: GradientBoostingRegressor on 2048-bit RDKit hashed AtomPair fingerprints
data_representation: RDKit hashed AtomPair fingerprints (2048 bits) generated via atompair_representation.py; converts SMILES to GetHashedAtomPairFingerprintAsBitVect (nBits=2048), outputs NPZ with X (and y if present) plus meta JSON (n_bits, invalid indices).

model_architecture: ChemBERTa (transformer encoder) via AutoModelForSequenceClassification checkpoint DeepChem/ChemBERTa-10M-MTR, regression head (num_labels=1, problem_type='regression'), end-to-end fine-tuning
data_representation: ChemBERTa SMILES text tokenization using RobertaTokenizerFast from DeepChem/ChemBERTa-10M-MTR with max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True; dataset returns input_ids, attention_mask, and labels (LOG_HPPB) when present; no saved features, tokenization on-the-fly.

model_architecture: LightGBMRegressor (gradient boosting decision trees)
data_representation: Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, nBits=2048, uint8) concatenated with RDKit 2D descriptor set filtered to non-NaN/non-constant columns, NaNs imputed with train means and standardized (mean/std fit on train; std=0 -> 1). Features returned as float32 array; meta stores kept descriptor indices/names, fill means, stds, n_bits, radius for reuse; meta saved as JSON.

model_architecture: CatBoostRegressor on combined features (Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits + RDKit 2D descriptors)
data_representation: Using existing combined featurizer (iteration 5): Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits) concatenated with RDKit 2D descriptors; continuous descriptors standardized with train-fitted mean/std stored in meta.json; featurize_smiles from combined_featurizer.py; invalid SMILES handled to NaN then zero-filled.

model_architecture: XGBoost regressor on combined features (Morgan r=2, 2048 bits + RDKit 2D descriptors)
data_representation: Reused combined featurizer from iteration 5: concatenation of Morgan fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits, useChirality=False, useFeatures=False) and RDKit 2D descriptors. Invalid SMILES produce zero vectors. RDKit descriptors standardized via stored mean/std in featurizer_meta.json (fitted on train); if missing, fit on train then reuse. Output feature vector = [Morgan bits (2048) || standardized RDKit descriptors].

model_architecture: GradientBoostingRegressor on AtomPair hashed fingerprints (nBits=2048)
data_representation: Using AtomPair hashed fingerprints (from iteration_3 atompair_representation.py) with RDKit on SMILES. Parameters: nBits=2048, includeChirality=False, fromAtoms=None (default), use2D=True; outputs fixed-length sparse vectors converted to numpy arrays. Will featurize new split v2 train/validation accordingly.

model_architecture: LightGBMRegressor on combined features (Morgan radius=2, nBits=2048 + RDKit 2D descriptors)
data_representation: Combined featurizer: concatenate Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, nBits=2048, useCounts=False, useFeatures=False) with RDKit 2D descriptors. Fit descriptor mean/std on training set; store meta (descriptor indices, means, stds, n_bits, radius) in featurizer_meta.json. At inference, reuse stored meta to standardize descriptors and compute fingerprints; fill invalid/NaN with zeros; output dense numeric vector per molecule.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: Base A GradientBoostingRegressor on AtomPair (2048-bit) features; Base B LightGBMRegressor on combined Morgan( radius=2, 2048 bits) + RDKit 2D descriptors (scaled); Meta- model Ridge regression on base OOF predictions.
data_representation: Reused featurizers from prior iterations: (1) AtomPair hashed fingerprints: RDKit GetHashedAtomPairFingerprintAsBitVect with nBits=2048; invalid SMILES → zero vector, meta saved with n_bits and invalid indices. (2) Combined featurizer: Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, nBits=2048) concatenated with RDKit 2D descriptors. Descriptor pipeline fits on training split only: drop all- NaN/constant descriptors, compute fill means and stds, fill NaNs with means, standardize; store keep_indices, fill_means, stds, descriptor names, radius, n_bits in featurizer_meta.json. Morgan bits are uint8 converted to float32; descriptors scaled to float32; final feature matrix float32. Both featurizers expose fit/transform via saved meta; invalid SMILES/descriptors yield zero features before scaling/imputation.

model_architecture: Two-model sweep: (1) Ridge regression on MolFormer embeddings; (2) LightGBMRegressor on MolFormer embeddings. Selection by highest validation Pearson (tie-break lower RMSE).
data_representation: New MolFormer embedding featurizer (molformer_embeddings.py) using ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL- both-10pct via AutoTokenizer/AutoModel, SMILES tokenization with padding/truncation max_length=256, mean-pooled last hidden state with attention mask. GPU/AMP support, batch size default 32, skips invalid SMILES with zero-vector fallback. Featurize CSVs to cached npz/json containing X (float32 embeddings), optional y, validity mask, and meta. CLI provided for ad hoc featurization.

model_architecture: CatBoostRegressor (single model) on combined features (2048-bit Morgan radius=2 + standardized RDKit 2D descriptors)
data_representation: Combined featurizer: concatenate (1) Morgan fingerprint (radius=2, nBits=2048, useChirality=False, useFeatures=False, count-based ints clipped to presence) and (2) RDKit 2D descriptors filtered to the kept indices from iteration 10/11, standardized with train-fitted mean/std stored in featurizer_meta.json. Descriptor NaNs/inf or invalid SMILES are filled with descriptor means, then standardized; invalid SMILES produce all-zero feature vector. Uses train-fitted descriptor means/stds and kept descriptor index list from featurizer_meta.json; if meta absent, refit on current train.csv then save meta. Output feature vector length: 2048 + n_kept_descriptors (per saved meta).

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: Base A GradientBoostingRegressor on AtomPair FP (nBits=2048); Base B LightGBMRegressor on combined features (Morgan r=2, nBits=2048 + standardized RDKit 2D descriptors); Base C CatBoostRegressor on combined features; meta-model Ridge
data_representation: Re-used AtomPair hashed fingerprint (nBits=2048) from iteration 9 and the combined featurizer from iteration 10 (Morgan FP radius=2, nBits=2048 + standardized RDKit 2D descriptors). Fit descriptor selection/means/stds on the training split; store meta (kept descriptor indices/names, means, stds, n_bits, radius) in featurizer_meta.json for reuse. Invalid SMILES are represented as all-zero vectors.

model_architecture: Ridge regression (L2-regularized linear regression) on one-hot flattened amino acid sequences (1100 features).
data_representation: One-hot encoding over fixed-length (55) amino acid sequences. Each sequence is converted to a (55 x 20) binary matrix using the 20 canonical amino acids; unknown residues map to all-zero at that position. Matrices are flattened to 1,100-dimensional float vectors per sample. Targets (numeric_label) stored as float. Outputs saved as compressed NPZ: X (n_samples, 1100), y (n_samples,).

model_architecture: StandardScaler + ElasticNet regression (scikit-learn pipeline)
