model_architecture: Ensemble of 3 XGBoost binary:logistic gradient-boosted tree models with GPU acceleration (tree_method=gpu_hist fallback hist), averaged probabilities
data_representation: Concatenated features per SMILES: (1) 2048-d hashed atom-pair count fingerprint (RDKit AllChem.GetHashedAtomPairFingerprint); (2) 2048-d hashed Morgan count fingerprint (radius=2, useCounts=True); (3) filtered RDKit 2D descriptors (drop non-finite or zero-std columns fit on train, names saved to desc_names.json; same ordering at inference); (4) frozen MoLFormer-XL (ibm- research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct) pooled CLS embedding with max_length=256, padding/truncation, L2-normalized. Invalid SMILES -> all-zero for all blocks. Feature order: [atom_pair, morgan_count, descriptors, molformer_CLS]. Saved NPZ via CLI featurize_ap_morgan_desc_molformer.py; outputs X (and y if present).

model_architecture: Ensemble of gradient-boosted decision trees (XGBoost binary:logistic). Model A: single XGBoost on AP+RDKit descriptor features. Model B: bagged XGBoost (3 seeds) on AP+RDKit descriptors + MoLFormer- XL CLS embedding. Final probability = 0.6 * ModelA + 0.4 * mean(ModelB_seeds).
data_representation: Two featurizers used and concatenated per model as specified:

model_architecture: XGBoost binary classifier on atom-pair + filtered RDKit 2D descriptor features (binary:logistic, GPU-accelerated if available)
data_representation: Using atom-pair fingerprints concatenated with filtered RDKit 2D descriptors (featurize_ap_desc.py copied from iteration_13). Descriptor list is derived solely from training molecules: compute all RDKit 2D descriptors, drop any that yield NaN/inf or are constant on train, and save the kept names to desc_names.json for reuse. Featurization for each SMILES: attempt RDKit parse; if invalid, return zero vector of length (n_ap + n_desc). For valid molecules: generate Morgan atom-pair fingerprints (RDKit GetHashedAtomPairFingerprintAsBitVect) with the same parameters as iteration 13, convert to dense bits, compute descriptor values in the order from desc_names.json, concatenate [atom-pair bits | descriptor floats] without scaling/normalization. All downstream data splits (train/val/test) reuse the saved desc_names.json to ensure consistent dimensions. No feature scaling applied.

model_architecture: Weighted ensemble of two XGBoost binary:logistic models: (A) AP+RDKit descriptors (atom-pair 2048 hashed counts + filtered RDKit 2D descriptors) using iteration-13 settings; (B) AP+RDKit descriptors + frozen MoLFormer-XL CLS embedding (atom-pair 2048 counts + filtered RDKit 2D descriptors + L2-normalized MoLFormer embedding) using iteration-31 settings. Ensemble prob = w*pA + (1-w)*pB with w grid-searched on validation.
data_representation: Reused fixed featurizers from prior iterations: (1) AP+RDKit descriptors (iteration 13) — hashed atom-pair counts (2048 bits, count-based) concatenated with filtered RDKit 2D descriptors (desc_names fit on train, dropping non-finite/zero-variance columns); (2) AP+RDKit descriptors + frozen MoLFormer-XL CLS embedding (iteration 31) — atom-pair counts (2048) + same descriptor filtering (its own desc_names fit on train) + L2-normalized MoLFormer-XL CLS embedding with max_length=256, model kept frozen. Both desc_names.json saved for inference; no parameter changes.

model_architecture: Ensemble of XGBoost binary:logistic models: (A) single model on atom-pair + RDKit2D descriptors; (B) bagged ensemble of 5 XGBoost models on atom-pair + RDKit2D + frozen MoLFormer-XL CLS embedding, combined via weighted average.
data_representation: Will reuse two featurizers: (1) Atom-pair fingerprints (RDKit GetHashedAtomPairFingerprintAsBitVect, nBits=4096, targetSize=4096) concatenated with RDKit 2D descriptor vector; descriptor name list fitted on train and saved as desc_names_ap.json; invalid SMILES -> zeros. (2) Same AP+descriptor block plus frozen MoLFormer-XL CLS embedding (1536-d) from iteration_31 featurizer; descriptor name list fitted on train saved as desc_names_molformer.json; invalid SMILES -> zeros. No scaling/normalization. Features built on-the-fly for train/val/test using the saved descriptor name lists to ensure column alignment.

model_architecture: Ridge regression (linear model) on per-position one-hot encoded amino-acid sequences (sparse).
data_representation: Per-position one-hot encoding of protein sequences. All sequences have fixed length 1,273. Built a vocabulary of 20 amino acids from train+validation. Sequences are split into characters, one-hot encoded with scikit-learn OneHotEncoder (sparse_output=True) using fixed categories [vocab] repeated for each position. Outputs saved as sparse matrices X_train_ohe.npz and X_val_ohe.npz with float32 entries. Labels saved as y_train.npy and y_val.npy. Encoder serialized to encoder_ohe.joblib. Metadata stored in representation_meta.json with sequence_length, vocab, and paths.

model_architecture: RandomForestRegressor on AAC features
data_representation: Built amino acid composition (AAC) features: per sequence counts and normalized frequencies for alphabet derived from train+val (sorted unique chars). Output vectors are 40 dims (20 counts + 20 freqs). Saved X_train_aac.npy, X_val_aac.npy (float32), labels y_train.npy/y_val.npy, and metadata aac_meta.json with alphabet and feature description.

model_architecture: ElasticNet regression pipeline (StandardScaler -> ElasticNet)
data_representation: Dipeptide (2-mer) composition per sequence using alphabet from train+val (sorted unique). For each of the 400 ordered AA pairs, compute raw count across 1,272 overlapping windows (length 1,273 sequences, window size 2) and normalized frequency (count/1,272). Concatenate counts and frequencies → 800-d float32 vector. Saved artifacts: X_train_dipep.npy, X_val_dipep.npy, y_train.npy, y_val.npy, dipep_meta.json (alphabet, feature order, window_size=2, normalization_length=1272). Feature builder

model_architecture: Pipeline(StandardScaler(with_mean=False) -> LinearSVR(dual=True, loss='epsilon_insensitive', epsilon=0.1, C=1.0, tol=1e-4, max_iter=2000, random_state=42))
data_representation: Per-position BLOSUM62 encoding. Alphabet order fixed as [A,R,N,D,C,Q,E,G,H,I,L,K,M,F,P,S,T,W,Y,V]. Each sequence must be length 1273; non-canonical residues map to zeros. For each residue, take its 20-d BLOSUM62 row (hardcoded), producing a (1273,20) float32 matrix. Flatten to a 25,460-length 1D vector per sequence. Save features as X_train_blosum.npy / X_val_blosum.npy, labels as y_train.npy / y_val.npy, and meta in blosum_meta.json (alphabet, sequence_length=1273, feature_shape=[1273,20], flat_dim=25460).

model_architecture: 1D CNN regressor: Embedding(num_embeddings=21, embedding_dim=32, padding_idx=20) -> Conv1d(32,64,kernel_size=9,padding=4)+BatchNorm1d+GELU -> Conv1d(64,128,kernel_size=17,padding=8)+BatchNorm1d+GELU -> Conv1d(128,256,kernel_size=25,padding=12)+BatchNorm1d+GELU -> Global MaxPool1d + Global AvgPool1d concat (dim=512) -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(512,256)+GELU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(256,1); seed=42; CUDA enabled if available.
data_representation: Tokenized integer sequences of length 1273 using fixed vocab [A,R,N,D,C,Q,E,G,H,I,L,K,M,F,P,S,T,W,Y,V] mapped to indices 0-19; any other character maps to <UNK> index 20. Metadata saved in token_meta.json with vocab, unk_index=20, sequence_length=1273. Tensors built on-the-fly as int64 arrays of shape (1273,).

model_architecture: Pipeline: StandardScaler (with_mean=True) -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor
data_representation: ESM-2 embeddings (facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D): for each 1273-aa sequence, tokenize with AutoTokenizer(add_special_tokens=True, padding=True, truncation=False), run AutoModel in eval/no_grad with autocast(fp16 on CUDA) using batch_size=4, then mean-pool hidden states after masking special tokens (mask[:,0]=0 for CLS and zero out last nonzero/EOS per sample). Save float32 arrays X_train_esm.npy, X_val_esm.npy, labels y_train.npy/y_val.npy, and metadata esm_meta.json {model_id, embedding_dim, pooling=mean_no_specials, batch_size, fp16_used, sequence_length=1273}; Hugging Face cache reused locally.

model_architecture: scikit-learn pipeline: StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True) -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor
data_representation: Mutation-centric dense vector (1317 dims). Steps: (1) compute reference sequence as position-wise mode over training sequences (length 1273). (2) For each sequence, encode: position_bag (1273 binary mutated positions); mutant_amino_counts (20 counts for A,R,N,D,C,Q,E,G,H,I,L,K,M,F,P,S,T,W,Y,V at mutated sites); wildtype_amino_counts (same order for reference residues at mutated sites); num_mutations; blosum_delta_sum and mean (sum/mean over mutations of BLOSUM62[ref->mut] minus self- score); hydrophobicity_delta_sum and mean (Kyte-Doolittle differences ref->mut). Concatenate into float32 vector: [pos_bag, mutant_counts, wildtype_counts, num_mutations, blosum_delta_sum, blosum_delta_mean, hydro_delta_sum, hydro_delta_mean]. Saved artifacts: X_train_mut.npy, X_val_mut.npy, y_train.npy, y_val.npy, mutation_meta.json (reference sequence, alphabet order, feature names/order, scales).

model_architecture: Compare two pipelines: (1) StandardScaler -> Ridge Regression and (2) StandardScaler -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor; select by highest validation Spearman.
data_representation: ESM2_t30_150M_UR50D embeddings computed with HF tokenizer/model. Tokenization: add_special_tokens=True, padding per batch, no truncation. Model in eval with torch.no_grad, autocast(fp16 on CUDA) and batch_size=2. Pooling: mean over hidden states of non-special tokens (CLS and final special token masked out). Outputs stored as float32 matrices: X_train_esm150.npy, X_val_esm150.npy; targets y_train.npy, y_val.npy; metadata in esm150_meta.json (model_id, embedding_dim=640, pooling, batch_size, fp16_used=True, sequence_length=1273, tokenizer_add_special_tokens=True).

model_architecture: Two pipelines on ESM2_t33_650M embeddings: (1) StandardScaler -> Ridge Regression; (2) StandardScaler -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor
data_representation: Using ESM2_t33_650M_UR50D embeddings. A script build_esm650_embeddings.py will tokenize sequences (length 1273 validation enforced) with add_special_tokens=True, padding per batch, batch_size=1, model eval with torch.no_grad and autocast(fp16 on CUDA). Hidden states from layer 0/last_hidden_state are mean-pooled over non-special tokens (exclude CLS at position 0 and final special token via attention mask). Outputs are float32 arrays: X_train_esm650.npy and X_val_esm650.npy; labels y_train.npy/y_val.npy; metadata esm650_meta.json records model_id, embedding_dim, pooling description, batch_size, fp16_used, sequence_length=1273, padding policy.

model_architecture: ESM2_t12_35M_UR50D encoder with mean pooling (exclude special tokens) + regression head: Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(hidden,256) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(256,1); embeddings and encoder layers 0–9 frozen; layers 10–11, layer norms, and head trainable; deterministic seed=42
data_representation: On-the-fly HuggingFace tokenization using facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D with add_special_tokens=True and attention masks; enforce max sequence length 1273. Pooling: mean over token embeddings excluding special tokens (CLS index 0 and final token). Saved metadata in ft_esm_meta.json (model_id, sequence_length=1273, special-token handling). No precomputed features; sequences tokenized during training/inference.

model_architecture: Sparse linear model suite: Ridge regression, LinearSVR pipeline (StandardScaler with_mean=False + LinearSVR), and SGDRegressor with elastic net.
data_representation: Per-position one-hot encoding (sparse CSR) of 1273-length amino-acid sequences using vocab of 20 standard AAs (A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y). Encoder saved at encoder_ohe.joblib; precomputed matrices X_train_ohe.npz, X_val_ohe.npz; labels y_train.npy, y_val.npy. No changes from iteration 0 settings.

model_architecture: Pipeline(steps=[('svd', Pretrained TruncatedSVD(n_components=400, random_state=42)), ('scaler', StandardScaler(with_mean=True)), ('regressor', HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42, early_stopping=False, min_samples_leaf=20, max_bins=255))])
data_representation: Reused iteration_10 per-position one-hot encoding (encoder_ohe.joblib, X_train_ohe.npz, X_val_ohe.npz, y_train.npy, y_val.npy). Built a dimensionality-reduced feature set with TruncatedSVD(n_components=400, random_state=42) fitted on X_train_ohe. Transformed train/val to dense float32 arrays saved as X_train_svd.npy and X_val_svd.npy. Saved fitted SVD to svd_ohe.joblib and metadata (svd_meta.json) capturing n_components, random_state, explained_variance_ratio_, explained_variance_, and cumulative explained variance.

model_architecture: Scikit-learn pipeline: StandardScaler(with_mean=False) -> RBFSampler(n_components=3000, gamma grid search) -> Ridge regression (fit_intercept=True, solver='auto')
data_representation: Reused per-position one-hot encoding artifacts from iteration_11: encoder_ohe.joblib with fixed AA vocab and sequence length 1273, along with X_train_ohe.npz, X_val_ohe.npz, y_train.npy, y_val.npy copied into current working directory.

model_architecture: Fixed weighted ensemble of two pretrained components: model_a (iteration 10 one-hot linear model/pipeline loaded from best_model.joblib) and model_b (iteration 11 pipeline: encoder_ohe -> svd_ohe -> scaler -> hgbr_model). Final prediction = w*pred_a + (1-w)*pred_b, with w tuned on validation.
data_representation: Re-use the fixed per-position one-hot encoder (sequence length 1273, vocab of 20 canonical amino acids) from iteration_10. Each sequence is validated to length 1273, then transformed with encoder_ohe.joblib into a sparse CSR matrix of shape (n_samples, 1273*20). No new features or recomputation of X_train/X_val; encoding is performed on-the-fly during training/inference using the saved encoder. Label remains the numeric DMS binding score as-is.

model_architecture: Weighted ensemble of four pretrained regressors: (A) per-position one-hot encoder + linear regression (iteration10 best_model.joblib); (B) one-hot encoder -> TruncatedSVD -> StandardScaler -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor (iteration11); (C) BLOSUM62 features via build_blosum_features.py -> StandardScaler -> LinearSVR (iteration3); (D) ESM2_t12_35M embeddings mean-pooled -> StandardScaler -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor (iteration5). Final prediction is a nonnegative simplex-weighted sum of the four base predictions.
data_representation: Weighted ensemble inputs. No new encodings created. Reuse prior artifacts: (a) iteration10 per- position one-hot encoder (encoder_ohe.joblib) feeding linear model; (b) iteration11 encoder_ohe + svd_ohe + scaler feeding HistGradientBoostingRegressor; (c) iteration3 BLOSUM62 features via build_blosum_features.py and blosum_meta.json feeding StandardScaler + LinearSVR; (d) iteration5 ESM2_t12_35M embeddings (mean-pooled non-special tokens) via build_esm_embeddings.py/esm_meta.json feeding StandardScaler + HistGradientBoostingRegressor. Ensemble prediction = nonnegative simplex- weighted sum of the four base model outputs with weights optimized on validation.

model_architecture: Weighted ensemble of four fixed pretrained regressors (models A–D from iteration 14): (A) per- position one-hot + ridge regression; (B) one-hot -> Truncated SVD + scaling + HistGradientBoostingRegressor; (C) BLOSUM62 aggregated features + scaling + GradientBoostingRegressor; (D) ESM2_t12_35M mean-pooled embeddings + ridge regression. Ensemble weights constrained to non-negative simplex (sum=1), optimized on validation via randomized search over >=10,000 Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) samples plus the 4 vertices and equal-weight.
data_representation: Reusing iteration-14 representations without changes: (A) per-position one-hot encoding of 1273-aa sequences using encoder_ohe_a.joblib; (B) same one-hot passed through fitted Truncated SVD (svd_ohe_b.joblib) with subsequent scaling (scaler_b.joblib); (C) BLOSUM62 substitution scores per- position aggregated via build_blosum_features.py using blosum_meta.json, scaled by scaler_c.pkl; (D) ESM2_t12_35M mean-pooled embeddings computed with build_esm_embeddings.py using esm_meta.json; labels are numeric_label regression targets without transformation. No new features will be created.

model_architecture: Meta-learner: comparison between ElasticNetCV (with StandardScaler) and GradientBoostingRegressor on 4-D base prediction features
data_representation: Meta-feature stack from four fixed base model predictions. Steps: (1) Validate all sequences length=1273. (2) Load base artifacts: encoder_ohe_a.joblib+model_a.joblib, encoder_ohe_b.joblib+svd_ohe_b.joblib+scaler_b.joblib+hgbr_model.joblib, blosum_meta.json+build_blosum_features.py+scaler_c.pkl+model_c.pkl, esm_meta.json+model_d.joblib. (3) For A/B use stored encoders to one-hot encode per-position characters; A uses ridge regressor; B applies SVD then scaler then HGBR. (4) For C use BLOSUM62 encoding (fixed 20-dim per position flattened), scale, predict with model_c. (5) For D prefer cached ESM embeddings X_train_esm.npy/X_val_esm.npy (mean-pooled non-special tokens from facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D, fp16, batch=4 on GPU); otherwise compute via build_esm_embeddings.py; pass to model_d. (6) Create base_preds_train.csv/base_preds_val.csv with columns [id,y_true,pred_a,pred_b,pred_c,pred_d]. (7) Save X_train_meta.npy/X_val_meta.npy as float32 matrices of shape (n_samples,4) with column order [pred_a,pred_b,pred_c,pred_d], and y_train.npy/y_val.npy. (8) Record meta_features_meta.json summarizing feature order, artifacts_dir, sequence length, and cache usage.

model_architecture: Non-negative simplex-constrained weighted ensemble over four base predictors (pred_a one-hot ridge, pred_b one-hot+SVD+HGBR, pred_c BLOSUM62+SVR, pred_d ESM2_t12_35M+HGBR). Ensemble weight vector w∈R^4, w_i≥0, Σw_i=1, optimized on validation Spearman via multi-start SLSQP.
data_representation: Reuse four base feature/prediction pipelines from iteration 15/16: (A) per-position one-hot encoding of amino acid sequences fed to ridge regressor (encoder_ohe_a.joblib + model_a.joblib); (B) per- position one-hot → truncated SVD (svd_ohe_b.joblib) → standard scaler (scaler_b.joblib) → Histogram Gradient Boosting Regressor (hgbr_model.joblib); (C) BLOSUM62 substitution features built via build_blosum_features.py → scaler_c.pkl → SVR model_c.pkl; (D) ESM2_t12_35M_UR50D mean-pooled embeddings using build_esm_embeddings.py/esm_meta.json with batch_size=4 and autocast → HGB model_d.joblib. Base predictions cached in base_preds_train.csv and base_preds_val.csv from iteration 16; recompute only if missing using the same pipelines. Ensemble representation is the weighted sum of the four base predictions with non-negative weights normalized to sum to 1, optimized on validation Spearman.

model_architecture: Ensemble of 5 bases: (A) one-hot Ridge (model_a.joblib); (B) one-hot -> SVD -> scaler -> Histogram Gradient Boosting Regressor (svd_ohe_b.joblib, scaler_b.joblib, hgbr_model.joblib); (C) BLOSUM62 + scaler + SVR (blosum_meta.json, scaler_c.pkl, model_c.pkl); (D) ESM2_t12_35M mean-pooled embeddings + HGBR (esm_meta.json, model_d.joblib); (E) NEW one-hot Ridge with weighted samples
data_representation: Re-use per-position one-hot (length 1273, canonical 20 AA alphabet) via encoder_ohe.joblib; no new features or transforms added this iteration.

Sequences uppercased and centrally cropped to 1024 bp; padded/truncated to max_len=1024 via tokenizer. Model run in eval + no_grad (prefer GPU). Last hidden states mean-pooled over non-pad tokens to produce float32 embedding (dim=hidden_size). Batch processing (BATCH_SIZE=4). Sequences uppercased, centrally cropped to max_len=1024, tokenized, padded/truncated to 1024. Model run in eval with no_grad (float16 on GPU if available, otherwise float32). Last hidden states mean-pooled over non-pad tokens to produce float32 embedding of size hidden_size (detected programmatically). Batch size 2. model_architecture: PyTorch 1D CNN with reverse-complement handling: Embedding(num_embeddings=5, embedding_dim=8, padding_idx=4) -> four parallel Conv1d blocks (out_channels=128, kernel_sizes=[8,16,24,48], stride=1, padding=0) each with Conv1d -> BatchNorm1d -> GELU -> global max pool over length; concatenate pooled outputs (dim=512) -> Dropout(0.5) -> Linear(512,256) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.5) -> Linear(256,1) logits. Gradient clipping max_norm=1.0, seed=42, GPU if available.
data_representation: Reused integer tokenization from iteration 7: map A=0, C=1, G=2, T=3, pad=4. Sequences uppercase, centrally crop/pad to fixed length 3072. Representation files loaded (not regenerated): train_seq.npy, val_seq.npy, train_labels.npy, val_labels.npy, and cnn_representation_meta.json from iteration_7.

model_architecture: PyTorch 1D CNN with residual dilated blocks plus multi-scale pooling: Embedding(num_embeddings=5, embedding_dim=16, padding_idx=4) -> 3 residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4], each block: Conv1d(in_ch,128,k=9,padding=4*d,dilation=d), BatchNorm1d, GELU, Conv1d(128,128,k=9,padding=4*d,dilation=d), BatchNorm1d, residual 1x1 Conv1d if channel mismatch, GELU on sum, dropout 0.1 after activation. Parallel multi-scale convs on embedding output with k in {8,16,32}: Conv1d(16,128,k), BatchNorm1d, GELU, global max pool. Base models: (A) LightGBMRegressor (objective=l1, boosting_type=gbdt, num_leaves=192, max_depth=-1, learning_rate=0.02, n_estimators=12000, feature_fraction=0.8, bagging_fraction=0.8, bagging_freq=1, min_data_in_leaf=15, min_sum_hessian_in_leaf=1e-3, lambda_l1=0.0, lambda_l2=1.0, metric=l1, seed=42, device_type=gpu w/ CPU fallback, early_stopping_rounds=800); (B) CatBoostRegressor (loss_function=MAE, task_type=GPU w/ CPU fallback, iterations=5000, learning_rate=0.03, depth=8, l2_leaf_reg=5.0, subsample=0.8, random_strength=0.5, bagging_temperature=0.8, eval_metric=MAE, od_type=Iter, od_wait=300, use_best_model=True, random_seed=42); (C) XGBoostRegressor (objective=reg:pseudohubererror or reg:absoluteerror fallback, eval_metric=mae, tree_method=gpu_hist w/ hist fallback, predictor=gpu_predictor if available, n_estimators=2000, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=6, min_child_weight=1.0, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, gamma=0.0, reg_alpha=0.0, reg_lambda=1.0, early_stopping_rounds=200, random_state=42); (D) ExtraTreesRegressor (n_estimators=1600, max_features=sqrt, min_samples_leaf=2, min_samples_split=2, bootstrap=False, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42). model_architecture: ESM2 (facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D) encoder fine-tuned end-to-end with masked mean-pooling over residues (attention_mask with CLS/EOS masked) concatenated with CLS token; pooling -> LayerNorm -> Linear(960,512) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(512,1) regression head
data_representation: On-the-fly tokenization of uppercase sequences using HuggingFace AutoTokenizer for facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D with add_special_tokens=True, padding/truncation to max_length≈343; create attention_mask. In model forward, construct residue_mask from attention_mask, zero out CLS (index 0) and EOS/pad (last token), pool by mean over valid residues; optionally concat CLS embedding before regression head.

model_architecture: Frozen facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D encoder with custom regression head: LayerNorm(1280) → Linear(1280,512) → GELU → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(512,128) → GELU → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(128,1).
data_representation: On-the-fly ESM2 encoding. For each sequence: uppercase; tokenize with Hugging Face AutoTokenizer for facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D using add_special_tokens=True, padding/truncation to max_length=343. Build attention_mask. Pass to frozen ESM2 encoder with torch.no_grad and mixed precision on GPU to obtain last_hidden_state. Pool by concatenating (a) CLS embedding (token index 0) and (b) mean over residue tokens only, excluding CLS and EOS/pad (mask out positions where attention_mask==0 or special tokens at CLS/EOS). Result is 1280-d float32 feature (2×640) per sequence. No offline caching; computed in training/inference batches.

model_architecture: LightGBMRanker (LambdaRank objective) on 5-D meta-features from base models

Output float32 vector of length 21. Feature names are the AA keys plus 'seq_len'.

model_architecture: Residual dilated 1D CNN (DNA 4x500): initial Conv1d 4→64 k11 p5 d1 + BN + ReLU; four residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8] and channels [64,128,128,256], each block: Conv1d(in→out,k11,p=dilation*5,d=dilation) + BN + ReLU + Dropout(0.1) + Conv1d(out→out,k7,p=dilation*3,d=dilation) + BN, residual skip with 1x1 if channel change, final ReLU. After last block: global max pool + global avg pool concat (dim C) → Dropout(0.5) → Linear(out*2→1 logit). Loss BCEWithLogitsLoss.

model_architecture: CatBoostRegressor (GPU if available) on concatenated features [Morgan counts r2 2048 + Morgan counts r3 2048 + RDKit 2D descriptors]. loss_function=RMSE, eval_metric=RMSE, early stopping od_type=Iter, od_wait=200.
data_representation: Concatenated float32 feature vector per SMILES: [Morgan count fingerprint radius 2, 2048 bits, useChirality=True] || [Morgan count fingerprint radius 3, 2048 bits, useChirality=True] || [RDKit 2D descriptors]. Descriptor set fixed from training (descriptor_names stored in metadata JSON) to ensure consistent ordering. Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors. Total dimension = 4096 + len(descriptor_names). Featurization utilities in combined_features.py include metadata save/load and featurize_with_metadata for consistent inference.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble of three base learners on combined RDKit+Morgan features with Ridge meta-learner
data_representation: Using combined_features.py from iteration 8: concatenated feature vector of length 4096 + n_desc.

model_architecture: LogisticRegression (binary, linear classifier) trained on RDKit Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 2048-bit)
data_representation: Morgan (ECFP) fingerprints from RDKit: radius=2, n_bits=2048, folded binary bit vectors. Pipeline: read CSV (columns Drug,id[,numeric_label]), convert SMILES to RDKit Mol, compute GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect, convert to numpy uint8 array shape (2048,), stack to X; preserve id as array; y included if present. Invalid SMILES are skipped with a warning. Output saved via joblib as dict {'X': X, 'id': id, 'y': y (optional)}. Script: representation.py with CLI args --input_csv, --output_pkl, --radius (default 2), --n_bits (default 2048).

model_architecture: RandomForestClassifier with MACCS 167-bit features
data_representation: Added RDKit MACCS (167-bit) featurization. Script representation_maccs.py reads input CSV with columns Drug,id[,numeric_label], converts SMILES to rdMolDescriptors.GetMACCSKeysFingerprint, converts to numpy uint8 array shape (167,), skips and logs invalid SMILES, stacks into X with aligned id (and y if present), and saves joblib dict {'X': X, 'id': id, 'y': y(optional)}. CLI: --input_csv, --output_pkl.

model_architecture: Pipeline(StandardScaler -> LinearSVC(l2, squared_hinge, C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42) -> CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=3)) on RDKit 2D descriptor features
data_representation: RDKit 2D descriptor featurization via representation_descriptors.py. Script reads input CSV (Drug, id, optional numeric_label), converts SMILES to Mol, computes all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors._descList values, drops descriptor columns with any NaN/Inf or that are constant, replaces residual NaN/Inf with 0, and returns float32 feature matrix X with aligned id (and y if present). Invalid SMILES are logged and kept with NaN values before column filtering. Output saved as joblib dict {X, id, y(optional), feature_names}. CLI: --input_csv, --output_pkl.

model_architecture: LogisticRegression on character-level TF-IDF SMILES
data_representation: Character-level TF-IDF on SMILES: TfidfVectorizer(analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32) fitted on train Drug strings. Outputs sparse TF- IDF matrix aligned with ids; saved as joblib dict {'X': sparse_matrix, 'id': id_array, 'y': y_array_if_present} and vectorizer.pkl. Script: representation_tfidf_smiles.py with modes fit (fit+transform, save features & vectorizer) and transform (load vectorizer.pkl, transform new CSV).

model_architecture: HuggingFace AutoModelForSequenceClassification (Roberta-based) using pretrained DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MLM, fine-tuning all layers
data_representation: Tokenize SMILES column `Drug` on the fly using HuggingFace RobertaTokenizerFast from pretrained model DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MLM with settings: padding='max_length', truncation=True, max_length=512. No separate feature file; labels use numeric_label column. Datasets return input_ids, attention_mask, labels (and id for tracking).

model_architecture: XGBoostClassifier on count-based Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True, dense float32) with tree_method='gpu_hist' if GPU available, else 'hist'
data_representation: New script representation_morgan_counts.py: generates count-based hashed Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) as dense float32 arrays per SMILES. CLI: python representation_morgan_counts.py input_csv output_pkl [--smiles-col Drug --id-col id --target-col Y --radius 2 --n-bits 2048]. Handles invalid SMILES with warnings; saves joblib dict {'X': X_array, 'id': id_array, 'y': y_array_if_present}.

model_architecture: Ensemble of two XGBoostClassifier (GPU) models: Model A on Morgan count FP radius=2 n_bits=2048; Model B on Morgan count FP radius=3 n_bits=4096; ensemble by averaging positive-class probabilities.
data_representation: Generated count-based Morgan fingerprints using updated representation_morgan_counts.py (zeroes invalid SMILES). Produced four PKLs: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r2_2048_val.pkl (radius=2, n_bits=2048); morgan_counts_r3_4096_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_val.pkl (radius=3, n_bits=4096), with columns mapped from Drug (SMILES), id, numeric_label.

model_architecture: XGBoostClassifier on concatenated features [Morgan2 counts (2048) || Morgan3 counts (4096) || RDKit 2D descriptors (filtered)]; GPU-accelerated (tree_method=gpu_hist, predictor=gpu_predictor)
data_representation: New on-the-fly combined featurizer (combined_featurizer.py): concatenates Morgan count fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits, useCounts=True) + Morgan count fingerprints (radius=3, 4096 bits, useCounts=True) + RDKit 2D descriptors filtered on training SMILES (drop NaN/Inf or constant columns). Invalid SMILES yield zero fingerprints and zero descriptors. Featurizer fits on train to select descriptor names; transforms train/val/test with fixed names. Metadata records descriptor names and params; feature order = [morgan2_count_* || morgan3_count_* || descriptors]. No scaling applied.

model_architecture: Bagged XGBoost ensemble (4 binary:logistic models using GPU)
data_representation: Re-used representation_morgan_counts.py from iteration 6 to generate (or reuse) Morgan count

model_architecture: LightGBM ensemble (Model A + Model B) on concatenated Morgan count fingerprints [radius=2, n_bits=2048 || radius=3, n_bits=4096], CPU inference/training
data_representation: Morgan count fingerprints concatenated: (1) radius=2, n_bits=2048 count-based; (2) radius=3, n_bits=4096 count-based. Invalid SMILES mapped to zero vectors. Features concatenated as [r2_2048 || r3_4096] dense arrays. PKLs reused: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train/val.pkl and morgan_counts_r3_4096_train/val.pkl. Targets aligned by id/Drug.

model_architecture: Ensemble: XGBoost GPU Model A + XGBoost GPU Model B + LightGBM CPU Model C on concatenated Morgan count features (r2_2048 || r3_4096).
data_representation: Concatenate precomputed Morgan count fingerprints: radius-2, size 2048 (counts) and radius-3, size 4096 (counts). Use representation_morgan_counts.py to generate/reuse PKLs: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r2_2048_val.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_val.pkl. For each molecule SMILES in train/validation, compute RDKit Morgan fingerprints with useCounts=True, nBits=2048 (r=2) and nBits=4096 (r=3). Invalid SMILES yield zero vectors of matching length. Maintain original row order and alignment across splits. Final feature vector per sample = [r2_2048 || r3_4096] (total dim 6144) as dense float32 arrays. Labels unchanged.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble with four base learners and one meta-learner: (1) XGBoost on Morgan counts r2_2048 with GPU hist; (2) XGBoost on Morgan counts r3_4096 with GPU hist; (3) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 counts; (4) Logistic Regression on char-level TF-IDF SMILES; Meta-learner: Logistic Regression on base-model probabilities.
data_representation: Re-use Morgan count fingerprints and char TF-IDF per instructions. Features: r2_2048 (Morgan radius=2, nBits=2048, useCounts=True), r3_4096 (radius=3, nBits=4096, useCounts=True); invalid SMILES -> zero vectors. TF-IDF: analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32; fit on train only, save vectorizer.pkl; transform train/val to sparse matrices. Stack base model outputs later as meta-features.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: base learners (1) LightGBM two-model ensemble on concatenated Morgan counts [radius2 2048 || radius3 4096]; (2) XGBoost two-model ensemble on Morgan counts r2/r3 separately; (3) TF-IDF (char 3-5) + Logistic Regression; meta-learner Logistic Regression on stacked base probabilities.
data_representation: Reusing fixed featurizations per instructions: (1) Morgan count fingerprints: radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True and radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True; invalid SMILES map to zero vectors. Concatenate r2||r3 for LightGBM; use r2 alone for XGB model A and r3 alone for XGB model B. (2) Char-level TF-IDF on SMILES: analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32. Features generated on-the-fly for train/val/test; no new split created.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: 4 base learners + meta-learner. Base models: LightGBM_A and LightGBM_B on concatenated Morgan count fingerprints [r2||r3]; XGBoost_A on r2; XGBoost_B on r3. Meta-learner: LogisticRegression on OOF base probabilities.
data_representation: Use dual Morgan count fingerprints generated on-the-fly from SMILES column `Drug`: r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) and r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Concatenate r2||r3 for LightGBM models; use r2 alone for XGBoost_A; r3 alone for XGBoost_B. Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors for both radii. Preserve feature ordering (r2 bits first, then r3 bits) across train/val/test. Labels taken from column `Y` (numeric).

model_architecture: Four models: (1) XGBoost binary:logistic on r2 Morgan count fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits, useCounts=True) with GPU tree_method=gpu_hist; (2) XGBoost binary:logistic on r3 Morgan count fingerprints (radius=3, 4096 bits, useCounts=True) with GPU tree_method=gpu_hist; (3) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 (6144 dims) configuration A; (4) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 (6144 dims) configuration B. Ensemble via weighted average over per-model probabilities (weights tuned on val simplex grid).
data_representation: Reused Morgan count fingerprints from iteration 6/10. Generate r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) and r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True) using representation_morgan_counts.py. Invalid SMILES → zero vectors. For LightGBM models concatenate r2 || r3 (dimension 2048+4096=6144, r2 bits first). For XGB_r2 use only r2; for XGB_r3 use only r3. Preserve this ordering across train/val/test.

model_architecture: Ensemble of five tree-based models: three XGBoost classifiers (r2, r3, r4 slices) using
data_representation: On-the-fly RDKit Morgan count fingerprints. For each SMILES: generate three vectors—r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True), r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True), r4 (radius=4, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors. For LightGBM models, concatenate in fixed order [r2 || r3 || r4]. For XGBoost models, use only the designated slice: XGB_r2 uses r2 only, XGB_r3 uses r3 only, XGB_r4 uses r4 only. No persisted PKL; featurize inside train/inference scripts. Preserve original row order and ids.

model_architecture: Ensemble on MolFormer CLS embeddings: LightGBMClassifier (CPU) + XGBoostClassifier (GPU, gpu_hist), averaged probabilities.
data_representation: Generated MolFormer CLS embeddings using ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct (AutoTokenizer/AutoModel with trust_remote_code). Tokenized SMILES column `Drug` with padding='max_length', truncation=True, max_length=256; batch size 12 on GPU, model.eval() with torch.no_grad(). CLS token embedding (last_hidden_state[:,0,:]) collected, cast to float32 CPU numpy. Handled invalid SMILES by substituting empty strings. Saved joblib PKLs: molformer_train.pkl and molformer_val.pkl with keys {'X': embeddings array, 'id': ids, 'y': labels if present}.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: 7 base models + logistic regression meta-learner. Base models: (1) XGBoost on r2 Morgan counts; (2) XGBoost on r3 counts; (3) XGBoost on r4 counts; (4) LightGBM model A on concatenated [r2||r3||r4] counts; (5) LightGBM model B on concatenated [r2||r3||r4] counts; (6) LightGBM on MolFormer embeddings; (7) XGBoost on MolFormer embeddings. Meta-learner: LogisticRegression (liblinear) on OOF probabilities.
data_representation: On-the-fly molecular featurization. For each SMILES (column Drug): generate three Morgan count vectors using RDKit (invalid SMILES -> all zeros): r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True), r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True), r4 (radius=4, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Concatenate [r2||r3||r4] (total 101... wait compute: 2048+4096+4096=101... hold up compute) for LightGBM models; use individual slices (r2 only, r3 only, r4 only) for respective XGBoost models. Additionally, use precomputed MolFormer embeddings (CLS token from ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct, max_length=256, batch_size≈12, float32) stored in molformer_train.pkl/molformer_val.pkl with keys {'X','id','y'} aligned to train/validation CSVs. If missing, regenerate embeddings accordingly. No scaling/normalization applied to counts or embeddings; keep native counts/float32.
